basic_details.job_title: Botad Family Court Counselor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Family Court, Botad has invited applications in the prescribed format from eligible candidates for the post of Counselors in the Botad District Family Courts, to prepare a panel of Counsellors under the Gujarat Family Court (Amendment) Rules, 2023. Applications go to The Principal Judge, Family Court, Botad, and the last date for receipt of the application is 26 November 2026 (upto 06:10 PM). The notice does not state the number of posts.

qualification.details: Educational qualification: Degree of a recognized University, preferably with Social Science or Psychology as one of the subjects. Experience: Minimum experience of 02 (Two) Years in Social Work, Child Psychiatry or Family Counselling. Integrity: The applicant must have impeccable integrity. Age limit: As on the last date fixed for submission of application, a candidate must have attained the age of 35 years and must not have crossed the age of 65 years. Pay: The candidate appointed as Counsellor, Family Court shall be paid a Honorarium or Fee as may be determined and notified by State Government from time to time. No amount is printed in the notice. | Other things being equal, preference shall be given in the matter of appointment to a woman candidate having the requisite qualification. Other things being equal, preference shall be given to a candidate who has been a Judge or has experience of Counselling in family matters. The High Court may, in exceptional circumstances, relax the minimum academic qualifications. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

important_instructions: The appointment of Counsellor may be terminated on recommendation of the High Court, without assigning any reason, at any time before the expiry of his/her term, on the recommendation of the concerned Principal Judge, Family Court. The applicant signs a declaration that the information is true, complete and correct; if information is found false or incorrect, or ineligibility is detected, action can be taken against the applicant. The panel is prepared under the Gujarat Family Court (Amendment) Rules, 2023.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Educational qualification: Degree of a recognized University, preferably with Social Science or Psychology as one of the subjects. Experience: Minimum experience of 02 (Two) Years in Social Work, Child Psychiatry or Family Counselling. Integrity: The applicant must have impeccable integrity. Age limit: As on the last date fixed for submission of application, a candidate must have attained the age of 35 years and must not have crossed the age of 65 years. Pay: The candidate appointed as Counsellor, Family Court shall be paid a Honorarium or Fee as may be determined and notified by State Government from time to time. No amount is printed in the notice. Other things being equal, preference shall be given in the matter of appointment to a woman candidate having the requisite qualification. Other things being equal, preference shall be given to a candidate who has been a Judge or has experience of Counselling in family matters. The High Court may, in exceptional circumstances, relax the minimum academic qualifications. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Botad Family Court Counselor Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists these duties and responsibilities of the Counsellor, Family Court: Work in association with the Family Court for promoting conciliation in and securing speedy settlement of disputes relating to marriage and family affairs and matters connected therewith. Not act or plead for a party to a case or proceeding, but generally assist the Court in reaching peaceful and amicable settlement of the dispute. Attend the Court as and when required by the Judge of the Family Court. Aid and advise the parties regarding settlement of the subject-matter of dispute or any other part thereof. Help the parties in reconciliation. Submit report or interim report, as required by the Court to which he/she is attached, and perform other functions assigned by that Family Court from time to time.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Passport size coloured photo, affixed on the form. Certification of educational qualification (Bachelor's Degree onwards). Certification of experience in the field of Social and Family Welfare, as required under Rule 5(B) of the Gujarat Family Court (Amendment) Rules, 2023. Copy of the order of appointment, if you have ever worked as Counselor in a Family Court.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date for the Botad Family Court Counselor application?
faq.answer: The application must be received by 26 November 2026, upto 06:10 PM.

faq.question: Q2. What qualification is needed for Counselor in Botad Family Court?
faq.answer: A degree of a recognized University, preferably with Social Science or Psychology as one of the subjects, with minimum 02 (Two) years' experience in Social Work, Child Psychiatry or Family Counselling, and impeccable integrity.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Botad Family Court Counselor post?
faq.answer: As on the last date fixed for submission of application, a candidate must have attained the age of 35 years and must not have crossed the age of 65 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of a Family Court Counselor in Botad?
faq.answer: The Counsellor is paid a Honorarium or Fee as may be determined and notified by State Government from time to time; no amount is printed in the notice.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the Botad Family Court Counselor post?
faq.answer: Fill in the prescribed application form printed with the advertisement, affix a passport size coloured photo, attach the certificates, and send it to The Principal Judge, Family Court, Botad so that it is received by 26 November 2026, 06:10 PM.

faq.question: Q6. Who gets preference in the Botad Family Court Counselor appointment?
faq.answer: Other things being equal, preference is given to a woman candidate having the requisite qualification, and to a candidate who has been a Judge or has experience of Counselling in family matters.

faq.question: Q7. Can the qualification for Family Court Counselor be relaxed?
faq.answer: Yes, the High Court may, in exceptional circumstances, relax the minimum academic qualifications.

faq.question: Q8. Can the Counselor appointment be ended before the term is over?
faq.answer: Yes, the appointment may be terminated on recommendation of the High Court, without assigning any reason, at any time before the expiry of the term, on the recommendation of the concerned Principal Judge, Family Court.
